muyesser-irab:49-49.t:
﴿وإنا﴾: likewise a conjunction; and inna, with ﴿نا﴾ as the ism (noun) of inna.
﴿لنعلم﴾: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); and نعلم is an imperfect verb, with its fāʿil (agent) a latent (mustatir) pronoun; the clause نعلم is the khabar (predicate) of inna.
﴿أن﴾: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh) that puts the noun in the accusative and the predicate in the nominative; أن together with what follows stands in place of the two objects of نعلم.
﴿منكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar of أن.
﴿مكذبين﴾: the postponed ism of أن.

muyesser-irab:50-50.t:
﴿وإنه﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; inna is an abrogating particle; and the hāʾ is an indeclinable (mabnī) pronoun in the position of the accusative (manṣūb) as the ism of inna.
﴿لحسرة﴾: the lām: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); and حسرة is the khabar (predicate) of inna.
﴿على الكافرين﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تذكرة﴾, or a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿حسرة﴾. [Translator's note: ﴿تذكرة﴾ does not occur in this ayah; it is the word of the ayah 48 (﴿وإنه لتذكرة للمتقين﴾), apparently carried over from there. Here the word is ﴿حسرة﴾.]

muyesser-irab:51-51.t:
﴿وإنه﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; inna is an abrogating particle; and the hāʾ is an indeclinable (mabnī) pronoun in the position of the accusative (manṣūb) as the ism of inna.
﴿لحق﴾: the lām: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); and حق is the khabar (predicate) of inna.
﴿اليقين﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:52-52.t:
﴿فسبح﴾: the fāʾ of eloquence (al-fāʾ al-faṣīḥa); and سبّح is an imperative verb.
﴿باسم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿سبح﴾; or the bāʾ is connective (ṣila).
﴿ربك﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿العظيم﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿ربك﴾.

muyesser-irab:1-1.t: ﴿الحاقة﴾: «الحاقة» is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and what follows it is its khabar (predicate); or it is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ.

muyesser-irab:2-2.t:
﴿ما﴾: «ما» is an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ) as a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿الحاقة﴾: the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. The nominal clause is the khabar of «الحاقة», and the link (rābiṭ) is the repetition of the mubtadaʾ in its own wording. The clause ﴿الحاقة ما الحاقة﴾ is initial (ibtidāʾiyya).

muyesser-irab:3-3.t:
﴿وما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, or parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya). ﴿ما﴾ is an interrogative noun in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ) as a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿أدراك﴾: a past verb; the kāf is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of «ما».
﴿ما﴾: the second [«ما»], likewise an interrogative noun in the position of a nominative as a mubtadaʾ.
﴿الحاقة﴾: the khabar; the clause ﴿ما الحاقة﴾ is in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), standing in place of the second and third objects of the verb ﴿أدراك﴾, because «أدرى» takes three objects in the accusative. The clause ﴿ما أدراك ما الحاقة﴾ is conjoined to the preceding clause, or parenthetical, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:4-4.t:
﴿كذبت﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; «كذبت» is a past verb.
﴿ثمود﴾: the fāʿil (agent).
﴿وعاد﴾: conjoined to «ثمود».
﴿بالقارعة﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿كذبت﴾.

muyesser-irab:5-5.t:
﴿فأما﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «أما» is a particle of condition and detailing (tafṣīl).
﴿ثمود﴾: a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿فأهلكوا﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb) of «أما»; «أهلكوا» is a past verb built for the one whose agent is not named (passive), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
﴿بالطاغية﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أهلكوا﴾; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of «ثمود».

muyesser-irab:6-6.t:
﴿وأما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «أما» is a particle of condition and detailing (tafṣīl).
﴿عاد﴾: a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿فأهلكوا﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb) of ﴿أما﴾; «أهلكوا» is a past verb built for the one whose agent is not named (passive), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
﴿بريح﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أهلكوا﴾; the clause ﴿فأهلكوا﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of «عاد».
﴿صرصر﴾: an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿ريح﴾, made genitive (majrūr) by the kasra.
﴿عاتية﴾: likewise an adjective of ﴿ريح﴾.

muyesser-irab:7-7.t:
﴿سخرها﴾: a past verb and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), referring back to Allah; the clause is a third adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿ريح﴾.
﴿عليهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿سخرها﴾.
﴿سبع﴾: accusative as an adverb of time (ʿalā al-ẓarfiyya al-zamāniyya).
﴿ليال﴾: a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿وثمانية﴾: conjoined to «سبع ليال».
﴿أيام﴾: a muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿حسوما﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of «سبع ليال وثمانية أيام»; or a maṣdar (verbal noun) made accusative (manṣūb) by a verb from its own root, i.e.: «تحسمهم حسومًا» (cutting them off utterly); or a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the object of «سخرها», i.e.: «ذات حسوم» (possessing cutting-off); or a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose).
﴿فترى﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «ترى القوم»: an imperfect verb and a latent fāʿil.
﴿القوم﴾: a mafʿūl bihi.
﴿فيها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ترى﴾.
﴿صرعى﴾: a ḥāl, because seeing here is visual.
﴿كأنهم﴾: «كأن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and ﴿هم﴾ is its noun.
﴿أعجاز﴾: the khabar (predicate) of «كأن», in the nominative (marfūʿ).
﴿نخل﴾: a muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿خاوية﴾: a naʿt of ﴿نخل﴾, in the genitive (majrūr); the clause ﴿كأنهم...﴾ is a ḥāl from «القوم», or resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:8-8.t:
﴿فهل﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «هل» is an interrogative particle.
﴿ترى﴾: an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ); its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being «أنت» (you).
﴿لهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ترى﴾.
﴿من﴾: a redundant (ṣila) preposition.
﴿باقية﴾: genitive (majrūr) in form and accusative (manṣūb) in position, because it is the object of «ترى».

muyesser-irab:9-9.t:
﴿وجاء﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position, or conjoined to what precedes it; «جاء» is a past verb.
﴿فرعون﴾: the fāʿil (agent).
﴿ومن﴾: conjoined to «فرعون».
﴿قبله﴾: an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾; the clause of the ṣila has no grammatical position.
﴿والمؤتفكات﴾: likewise conjoined.
﴿بالخاطئة﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿جاء﴾.

muyesser-irab:10-10.t:
﴿فعصوا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «عصوا» is a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿رسول﴾: a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿ربهم﴾: a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿فأخذهم﴾: conjoined to ﴿فعصوا﴾.
﴿أخذة﴾: it stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).
﴿رابية﴾: a naʿt (adjective). The hamza of «أخذة» takes fatḥa because it is a maṣdar of single occurrence (maṣdar marra), not a maṣdar of manner (maṣdar hayʾa); the meaning of manner is derived only from the naʿt.

muyesser-irab:11-11.t:
﴿إنا﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun.
﴿لما﴾: a temporal adverb (ẓarfiyya ḥīniyya), or linking.
﴿طغى﴾: a past verb.
﴿الماء﴾: the fāʿil (agent), in the nominative (marfūʿ).
﴿حملناكم﴾: a past verb; ﴿نا﴾ is the fāʿil and the kāf is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of «إن».
﴿في الجارية﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿حملناكم﴾.

muyesser-irab:12-12.t:
﴿لنجعلها﴾: the lām is for giving the reason (taʿlīl); «نجعلها» is an imperfect verb made accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) «أن» after the lām; the interpreted maṣdar formed from «أن» and the verb is made genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿حملناكم﴾; ﴿ها﴾ is the first object of «نجعلها», and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun.
﴿لكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿تذكرة﴾: a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿وتعيها﴾: accusative by conjunction to «نجعل», and ﴿ها﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi.
﴿أُذن﴾: the fāʿil, in the nominative (marfūʿ).
﴿واعية﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of «أُذن».

muyesser-irab:13-13.t:
﴿فإذا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; «إذا» is an adverb for future time containing the meaning of condition, attached to (mutaʿalliq) its apodosis (jawāb).
﴿نفخ﴾: a past verb built for the one whose agent is not named (passive); the clause is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by the annexation of the adverb to it.
﴿في الصور﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿نفخ﴾.
﴿نفخة﴾: the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), in the nominative (marfūʿ).
﴿واحدة﴾: a naʿt (adjective), in the nominative.

muyesser-irab:14-14.t:
﴿وحملت﴾: a past verb built for the one whose agent is not named (passive), conjoined to «نفخ».
﴿الأرض﴾: the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
﴿والجبال﴾: conjoined to «الأرض».
﴿فدكتا﴾: likewise conjoined; «دك» is a past verb built for the one whose agent is not named; the tāʾ is the quiescent tāʾ of the feminine; and the alif is the nāʾib fāʿil.
﴿دكة﴾: it stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).
﴿واحدة﴾: a naʿt (adjective), in the accusative (manṣūb).

muyesser-irab:15-15.t:
﴿فيومئذ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); ﴿يومئذ﴾: «يوم» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿وقعت﴾, and «إذٍ» is a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on a sukūn implied (muqaddar) because the place is occupied by the nunation of compensation (tanwīn al-ʿiwaḍ), in the position of a genitive (majrūr) as a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the nunation compensates for a clause, the implied form being: «يوم إذ نفخ في الصور نفخة واحدة وحملت الأرض والجبال...» etc. (on the day when the Trumpet is blown with a single blast and the earth and the mountains are lifted …).
﴿وقعت﴾: a past verb, and the tāʾ is for the feminine.
﴿الواقعة﴾: the fāʿil (agent), in the nominative (marfūʿ).

muyesser-irab:16-16.t:
﴿وانشقت﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «انشقت» is a past verb.
﴿السماء﴾: the fāʿil (agent).
﴿فهي﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «هي» is a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿يومئذ﴾: «يوم» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿واهية﴾, and «إذٍ» is a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on a sukūn implied (muqaddar) because the place is occupied by the nunation of compensation (tanwīn al-ʿiwaḍ), in the position of a genitive (majrūr) as a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the nunation compensates for a clause.
﴿واهية﴾: the khabar (predicate) of «هي».

muyesser-irab:17-17.t:
﴿والملك﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and «الملك» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), in the nominative (marfūʿ).
﴿على أرجائها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of «الملك».
﴿ويحمل﴾: an imperfect verb in the nominative.
﴿عرش﴾: a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿ربك﴾: a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿فوقهم﴾: an adverb in the accusative (manṣūb), attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from «العرش», i.e.: in the state of its being above the angels.
﴿يومئذ﴾: «يوم» is an adverb of time attached to ﴿يحمل﴾, and «إذٍ» is a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on a sukūn implied (muqaddar) because the place is occupied by the nunation of compensation (tanwīn al-ʿiwaḍ), in the position of a genitive (majrūr) as a muḍāf ilayhi; the nunation compensates for a clause.
﴿ثمانية﴾: the fāʿil (agent), in the nominative.

muyesser-irab:18-18.t:
﴿يومئذ﴾: «يوم» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تعرضون﴾, and «إذٍ» is a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on a sukūn implied (muqaddar) because the place is occupied by the nunation of compensation (tanwīn al-ʿiwaḍ), in the position of a genitive (majrūr) as a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the nunation compensates for a clause.
﴿تعرضون﴾: an imperfect verb built for the one whose agent is not named (passive), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
﴿لا﴾: negating.
﴿تخفى﴾: an imperfect verb, made nominative (marfūʿ) by a ḍamma implied on the alif.
﴿منكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was originally an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿خافية﴾.
﴿خافية﴾: the fāʿil (agent), in the nominative; the clause is a ḥāl from the wāw in «تعرضون».

muyesser-irab:19-19.t:
﴿فأما﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and «أما» is a particle of condition or detailing (tafṣīl).
﴿من﴾: a relative noun in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ) as a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿أُوتي﴾: «أوتي» is a past verb built for the one whose agent is not named (passive).
﴿كتابه﴾: the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), the first being the latent (mustatir) nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause ﴿أوتي﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿بيمينه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أُتي﴾, and the hāʾ is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿فيقول﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb) of «أما», and the clause «يقول» is the khabar (predicate) of «من».
﴿هاؤم﴾: a verbal noun of command (ism fiʿl amr) in the sense of «خذوا» (take); the fāʿil (agent) is latent, its implied form being «أنتم» (you); the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying).
﴿اقرءوا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as a badal (substitute) from ﴿هاؤم﴾.
﴿كتابيه﴾: a mafʿūl bihi, made accusative by a fatḥa implied on what precedes the yāʾ; the yāʾ is a muḍāf ilayhi, and the hāʾ is for the pause (hāʾ al-sakt); the clause ﴿فأما من أوتي...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:20-20.t:
﴿إني﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the yāʾ is its noun.
﴿ظننت﴾: a past verb, and the tāʾ is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of the khabar (predicate) of «إن».
﴿أني﴾: «أن» is an abrogating particle, and the yāʾ is its noun.
﴿ملاقٍ﴾: the khabar of «أن», the sign of its being nominative (marfūʿ) being the ḍamma implied on the yāʾ that was dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; the «أن» clause stands in place of the two objects of «ظن».
﴿حسابيه﴾: the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿ملاق﴾, because it is the active participle; the yāʾ is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the hāʾ is for the pause (hāʾ al-sakt).

muyesser-irab:21-21.t:
﴿فهو﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition), and «هو» is a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿في عيشة﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of «هو».
﴿راضية﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿عيشة﴾, in the genitive (majrūr).

muyesser-irab:22-22.t:
﴿في جنة﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted badal (substitute) from His saying «في عيشة».
﴿عالية﴾: an adjective (ṣifa).

muyesser-irab:23-23.t:
﴿قطوفها﴾: a mubtadaʾ (subject), in the nominative (marfūʿ), and ﴿ها﴾ is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿دانية﴾: the khabar (predicate), in the nominative; the clause is a second adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿جنة﴾.

muyesser-irab:24-24.t:
﴿كلوا﴾: an imperative verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is the object of an omitted saying, i.e.: that is said to them.
﴿واشربوا﴾: conjoined to ﴿كلوا﴾.
﴿هنيئا﴾: a ḥāl (circumstantial), in the accusative (manṣūb), i.e.: «مهنئين» (with enjoyment).
﴿بما﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition «للسلبية» «[Translator's note: so in the source, evidently a slip for «للسببية» (causal).]», and «ما» is maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya) or relative; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿هنيئا﴾.
﴿أسلفتم﴾: a past verb, and the tāʾ is a pronoun in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ) as the fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position in either case.
﴿في الأيام﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أسلفتم﴾.
﴿الخالية﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿الأيام﴾, in the genitive (majrūr).

muyesser-irab:25-25.t:
﴿وأما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «أما» is a particle of condition or detailing (tafṣīl).
﴿من﴾: a relative noun in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ) as a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿أُوتي﴾: a past verb built for the one whose agent is not named (passive).
﴿كتابه﴾: the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), the first being the latent (mustatir) nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause ﴿أوتي﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿من﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿بشماله﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أُتي﴾, and the hāʾ is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿فيقول﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb) of ﴿أما﴾, and the clause «يقول» is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿من﴾.
﴿يا﴾: a vocative particle, the one addressed (munādā) being omitted; or [it is] merely for drawing attention.
﴿ليتني﴾: «ليت» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh) for wishing (tamannī); the nūn is for protection (wiqāya); and the yāʾ is its noun.
﴿لم﴾: a particle of the jussive and of conversion [to the past].
﴿أُوت﴾: an imperfect verb built for the one whose agent is not named, in the jussive (majzūm), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the weak letter; the nāʾib fāʿil is latent; the clause is in the position of a nominative as the khabar of «ليت».
﴿كتابيه﴾: the second mafʿūl bihi; the yāʾ is a muḍāf ilayhi, and the hāʾ is for the pause (hāʾ al-sakt).

muyesser-irab:26-26.t:
﴿ولم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «لم» is a particle of negation, of conversion [to the past] and of the jussive.
﴿أدر﴾: an imperfect verb made jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لم﴾.
﴿ما﴾: an interrogative noun in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ) as a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿حسابيه﴾: its khabar (predicate); the yāʾ is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the hāʾ is for the pause (hāʾ al-sakt); the clause stands in place of the two objects of «أدرِ», which is suspended (muʿallaq) from governing by the interrogative.

muyesser-irab:27-27.t: ﴿يا ليتها كانت القاضية﴾: the yāʾ «[Translator's note: i.e. «يا».]» is for the vocative or for drawing attention; «ليت» [and] its noun «[Translator's note: so worded in the source; i.e. «ليت» is an abrogating particle and the hāʾ is its noun.]», the pronoun referring back to the death in this world; the clause «كانت» is the khabar (predicate) of «ليت»; the noun of «كان» is a latent (mustatir) pronoun referring back to the death; and «القاضية» is the khabar of «كانت», in the accusative (manṣūb).

muyesser-irab:28-28.t:
﴿ما﴾: negating.
﴿أغنى﴾: a past verb.
﴿عنِّي﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أغنى﴾.
﴿ماليه﴾: the fāʿil (agent) of «أغنى»; the object is omitted for generalisation; and the hāʾ is for the pause (hāʾ al-sakt).
It has also been said: ﴿ما﴾ in His saying ﴿ما أغنى﴾ is interrogative, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), standing in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of ﴿أغنى﴾, the interrogative being for rebuke: he rebuked himself, saying: «أيَّ إغناءٍ أغنى عني مالي» (what avail has my wealth availed me?); or it is in the position of an accusative as a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), the implied form being: «أيَّ شيءٍ أغنى عني مالي» (what thing has my wealth availed me?).

muyesser-irab:29-29.t:
﴿هلك﴾: a past verb.
﴿عني﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿هلك﴾.
﴿سلطانيه﴾: the fāʿil (agent) of «هلك»; the yāʾ is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by annexation; and the hāʾ is for the pause (hāʾ al-sakt).

muyesser-irab:30-30.t:
﴿خذوه﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and the hāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿فغلوه﴾: conjoined to ﴿خذوه﴾; the address is to the Zabāniya appointed over the punishment. The clause «خذوه» is the object of an implied saying, and the clause of the saying is resumptive, with no grammatical position, brought to answer an implied question, as if it were said: And what is done with him after this lamentation that comes from him? And the reply was: It is said: Seize him.

muyesser-irab:31-31.t:
﴿ثم﴾: a conjunction for sequence with delay (al-tartīb maʿa al-tarākhī).
﴿الجحيم﴾: the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb indicated by the verb mentioned after it.
﴿صلوه﴾: an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:32-32.t:
﴿ثم﴾: a conjunction for sequence with delay (al-tartīb maʿa al-tarākhī).
﴿في سلسلة﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿اسلكوه﴾.
﴿ذرعها﴾: a mubtadaʾ (subject), and ﴿ها﴾ is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿سبعون﴾: the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ.
﴿ذراعا﴾: a tamyīz (specification).
﴿فاسلكوه﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «اسلكوه» is an imperative verb, the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and the hāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:33-33.t: ﴿إنه كان لا يؤمن بالله العظيم﴾: «إنّه»: «إنّ» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the hāʾ is its noun; «كان» is a defective (nāqiṣ), abrogating verb, and the noun of «كان» is latent (mustatir), its implied form being «هو» (he); the clause ﴿لا يؤمن﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of «كان»; «بالله»: the bāʾ is a preposition and the Name of Majesty is a genitive noun, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يؤمن﴾; «العظيم» is an adjective (ṣifa) of «الله»; and the clause is a resumptive statement of reason (taʿlīl), so it has no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:34-34.t:
﴿ولا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «لا» is negating.
﴿يحض﴾: an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ); its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being «هو» (he).
﴿على طعام﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يحض﴾.
﴿المسكين﴾: a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:35-35.t:
﴿فليس﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition), and «ليس» is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb.
﴿له﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate).
﴿اليوم﴾: an adverb attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), or attached to the meaning of settledness (istiqrār) contained in the khabar.
﴿ههنا﴾: «ها» is for drawing attention, and «هنا» is a demonstrative in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as an adverb, likewise attached to what «اليوم» is attached to.
﴿حميم﴾: the noun of «ليس».

muyesser-irab:36-36.t:
﴿ولا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «لا» is negating.
﴿طعام﴾: conjoined to «حميم».
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr).
﴿من غسلين﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿طعام﴾.

muyesser-irab:37-37.t:
﴿لا﴾: negating.
﴿يأكله﴾: an imperfect verb, and the hāʾ is a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr).
﴿الخاطئون﴾: the fāʿil (agent) of «يأكله», made nominative (marfūʿ) by the wāw.

muyesser-irab:38-38.t:
﴿فلا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and «لا» is redundant (ṣila).
﴿أُقسم﴾: an imperfect verb; its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being «أنا» (I).
﴿بما﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أقسم﴾.
﴿تبصرون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause ﴿تبصرون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. The clause ﴿فلا أقسم﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:39-39.t:
﴿وما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «ما» is relative, conjoined to the preceding ﴿ما﴾, in the position of a genitive (majrūr).
﴿لا﴾: negating.
﴿تبصرون﴾: an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿لا تبصرون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:40-40.t:
﴿إنه﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the hāʾ is its noun.
﴿لقول﴾: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and «قول» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن».
﴿رسول﴾: a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿كريم﴾: an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿رسول﴾; the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the answer to the oath.

muyesser-irab:41-41.t:
﴿وما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and ﴿ما﴾ is the Ḥijāzī negating [«ما»], which governs as «ليس» does.
﴿هو﴾: the noun of «ما».
﴿بقول﴾: the bāʾ is a redundant (ṣila) preposition, and ﴿قول﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of the Ḥijāzī ﴿ما﴾, accusative in position and made genitive (majrūr) in form by the bāʾ.
﴿شاعر﴾: a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿قليلا﴾: it stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is an adjective of the omitted maṣdar, i.e.: «تؤمنون إيمانًا قليلًا» (you believe with little belief).
﴿ما﴾: redundant (ṣila), to emphasise the littleness.
﴿تؤمنون﴾: a verb and its fāʿil (agent). The clause ﴿تؤمنون﴾ is parenthetical, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:42-42.t:
﴿ولا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and ﴿لا﴾ is redundant (ṣila), to emphasise the negation.
﴿بقول كاهن﴾: conjoined to ﴿بقول شاعر﴾, and «كاهن» is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿قليلا﴾: it stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is an adjective of the omitted maṣdar, i.e.: «تتذكرون تذكرًا قليلًا» (you take heed with little heed).
﴿ما﴾: redundant (ṣila), to emphasise the littleness.
﴿تذكرون﴾: a verb and its fāʿil (agent). The clause ﴿تذكرون﴾ is parenthetical, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:43-43.t:
﴿تنزيل﴾: the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: «هو تنزيل» (it is a revelation).
﴿من رب﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تنزيل﴾.
﴿العالمين﴾: a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:44-44.t:
﴿ولو﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «لو» is conditional.
﴿تقوَّل﴾: a past verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir).
﴿علينا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تقول﴾.
﴿بعض﴾: it stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).
﴿الأقاويل﴾: a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:45-45.t:
﴿لأخذنا﴾: the lām occurs in the apodosis (jawāb) of ﴿لو﴾; ﴿أخذنا﴾ is a past verb, and ﴿نا﴾ is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿منه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أخذ﴾.
﴿باليمين﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause has no grammatical position, [being] the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.

muyesser-irab:46-46.t:
﴿ثم﴾: a conjunction for sequence with delay (al-tartīb maʿa al-tarākhī).
﴿لقطعنا﴾: conjoined to ﴿أخذنا﴾.
﴿منه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قطعنا﴾, or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿الوتين﴾: a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), in the accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its being accusative being the overt fatḥa.

muyesser-irab:47-47.t:
﴿فما﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and ﴿ما﴾ is the Ḥijāzī negating [«ما»], which governs as «ليس» does.
﴿منكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿أحد﴾.
﴿من﴾: a redundant (ṣila) preposition.
﴿أحد﴾: the noun of ﴿ما﴾, nominative (marfūʿ) in position and made genitive (majrūr) in form by ﴿من﴾.
﴿عنه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿حاجزين﴾.
﴿حاجزين﴾: the khabar (predicate) of the Ḥijāzī ﴿ما﴾, in the accusative (manṣūb).

muyesser-irab:48-48.t:
﴿وإنه﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); and the hāʾ is an indeclinable (mabnī) pronoun in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as the noun of «إن». The statement is conjoined to the preceding answer to the oath, so it is part of that which is sworn by (al-maqsūm bihi) «[Translator's note: so in the source; as part of the answer to the oath it belongs to what is sworn to (al-muqsam ʿalayhi).]».
﴿لتذكرة﴾: the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and «تذكرة» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن».
﴿للمتقين﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تذكرة﴾.
